prompt: Create a website for selling tacos. make it just a static site
summary: A single static brochure/menu site for a taco stand called El Fuego Tacos. The prompt explicitly asks for 'just a static site' selling tacos, and there's no requirement for user accounts, orders that persist, or server-side logic — the menu, prices, and story are fixed content that can ship as plain HTML/CSS/JS. That means a static_site is the entire footprint: no web_service (nothing needs to run per-request), no postgres (no data needs to outlive a request), and no key_value (nothing to cache or queue).
